messages:
frank: Filing this here — reproducible stall when using the paginator with the new client-side leaky-bucket limiter + auth-proxy that intermittently 401s. Setup: sampleapps/ingest-stream, concurrency=10, windowSize=200, leakRate=300/s. After a few minutes progress slows to zero.

tanya: Can you paste the minimal logs?

frank: Sure, trimmed:
```
2026-12-20T11:02:01.100Z DEBUG paginator: acquire window token (slot=7)
2026-12-20T11:02:01.101Z DEBUG transport -> /v1/complete id=812 401
2026-12-20T11:02:01.102Z DEBUG auth: refresh start (singleflight miss)
2026-12-20T11:02:01.103Z DEBUG limiter: tokens remaining 2
2026-12-20T11:02:01.350Z DEBUG auth: refresh done token=tok_xxx
2026-12-20T11:02:01.351Z DEBUG paginator: request waiting on limiter token
// many repeats then silence
```

ollie: Two things stand out: (A) retry path re-acquires limiter tokens immediately on refresh which can cause sudden fanout when limiter refills, (B) retry bypasses the in-flight guard so multiple retries process the same page.

sam: Do the other SDKs behave differently?

frank: Python uses a retry queue that preserves the in-flight marker; Go has a smoothing refill by default. Node optimized for latency and re-enters the limiter immediately.

tanya: Proposed fixes: 1) make retry/resubmit honor in-flight set (no bypass), 2) change re-enqueue to a jittered retryQueue instead of immediate token grab, 3) add optional limiter.smoothRefillMs so tokens are trickled in over a window. Also add a small metric paginator.duplicate_pages and auth.refresh_burst_count.

ollie: I can prototype a minimal change: push failed page IDs into retryQueue with randomized backoff and throttle dequeues to 10/s per worker. Keeps limiter behavior predictable.

sam: Also implement a single-flight refresh in the core auth module (if not already) so refresh storms don't create N parallel refresh attempts. But single-flight alone doesn't solve limiter fanout. We need both.

maria: For customer UX, expose Paginator options: { retryMode: 'queue' | 'immediate', smoothRefillMs: number (opt-in), windowMonitorMs: number (default 0) }. Default retryMode should be 'queue' to avoid surprises. Update onboarding quickstart with recommended defaults for bulk ingest.

frank: I prototyped the retryQueue locally — no duplicate page processing after 10k items with auth flapping at 15%. I'll open the sampleapps branch and add a deterministic unit test that asserts no dupes and no stalls under load.

ci-bot: CI started for branch frank/paginator-retry-queue #9

ollie: Nice. Add a tiny e2e that simulates the auth proxy returning 401 for the first attempt of each page and then 200 on retry. Assert all page IDs processed exactly once.

sam: For parity, update node SDK README and add a note in the SDK parity doc about aligning retry semantics across languages. Also add an observability doc entry explaining how to detect limiter fanout (spike in auth.refresh_burst_count + paginator.duplicate_pages).

maria: I'll review the PR. Also add a small changelog entry warning that older client versions may see duplicate processing under auth bursts and link to the mitigation config. :warning:

frank: Branch pushed and PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/sampleapps/pull/558 — includes retryQueue, smoothRefill option (opt-in), metrics, and unit+e2e tests.

ci-bot: CI passed for PR frank/paginator-retry-queue #558 (unit: 17/17, e2e: 1/1) :white_check_mark:
